description: A concrete detail was given 36 messages before the question. The reply should recall it. Used to test how much history the model needs.

history.text: my sister's wedding is on the 14th and i need to pick up my suit on thursday
ok, suit pickup thursday, wedding on the 14th. noted
did you watch anything last night
i don't watch things, but tell me what you saw
a cooking show, they made a cake shaped like a boat
a boat cake is a lot of structural engineering
right? the sails were just rice paper
rice paper sails is clever, edible and light
i've been trying to eat more vegetables lately
good move. which ones are you actually enjoying?
roasted carrots are weirdly great
carrots get sweet when they roast, it's the best trick
my neighbour got a new dog, it barks at everything
new dogs bark at everything for a while, then they settle
hopefully soon, it started at six this morning
six is brutal, did you get any sleep after?
a bit, then coffee happened
coffee is carrying a lot of people today
i should reorganise my desk, it's a disaster
what's the worst part of it right now?
cables mostly, and about nine mugs
nine mugs is a collection. start with the cables
true, i'll do it after lunch
lunch first is a solid plan
what's a good movie for a rainy afternoon
something slow and warm, nothing that needs full attention
something like a cosy mystery maybe
cosy mysteries are made for rain
do you ever get bored of chatting
not in a way i can point to, what made you ask?
just curious, i talk to you a lot
you do, and i like hearing how your days go
it's windy out, the bins fell over
windy bins, the classic. did they go far?
the whole street has recycling on it
that's a neighbourhood project now

script.user: wait what was i supposed to do on thursday again
